description: Galveston Island (TX) Electric Power Network Data is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Yousef Darestani, Michigan Technological University (mtu.edu). Galveston is a barrier island on the Texas coast approximately 50 miles southeast of Houston. This island has been historically impacted by hurricane/storm events such as Hurricane Ike in 2008. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 2 top-level files. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-j1fe-b390. Keywords: Electric Power Network, Wood Poles, Prestressed Concrete Poles, Transmission Towers, Connectivity Data, Distribution System. Published 2022-07-13. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
